data.body:
AC amendment: merge-to-main-pr.sh stub must not touch state file or lock

The stub exits 1 with error before calling any helper functions. Add AC: 'merge-to-main-pr.sh must not source merge-helpers.sh and must not write to /tmp/merge-to-main-state-* or /tmp/merge-to-main-lock-*'. Also document in the task: since this project's dso-config.conf will have merge.strategy=pr after Task 1, the .claude/scripts/dso merge-to-main.sh invocation will fail with stub error until S3a lands. This is expected and correct behavior — end-session/sprint workflow will fail at merge step. Workaround for development: temporarily set merge.strategy=direct locally, or run merge-to-main-direct.sh directly.
